cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

mechanism: A corrects a key search into trust-building, insisting B abandon physical checking even after agreeing to apologize.
confusable: D147 requests an apology; D156 here requires giving up the ordinary search, with apology as replacement method.
comparison: Offended invisible keys and immediate search differ from a responsive house with an electrician fallback.
seedUse: Keep cushion jingle and checking condition so A rejects a real ordinary explanation rather than an invented one.
